meta.name: Keegan Lanier
meta.title: Keegan Lanier — Operator. Technologist. Builder.
meta.description: Technology leader and product builder. I pair operational rigor with engineering to build software and web systems engineered for outcomes — home of Redefined Creative, Orva, and PlainMind.

hero.sub: I've run kitchens and P&Ls, scaled technology for hyper-growth brands, and now I build software and web systems that are engineered to move the number that matters — not just look the part.

operator.heading: Two lenses most people never combine.
operator.lede: A theme park runs on magic out front and ruthless systems in the back. I've spent my career on both sides of that line.

blocks.title: I learned business where the margins are thin.
blocks.body: Kitchens, food-service operations, P&Ls, and leading teams under pressure. At Walk-On's Sports Bistreaux, our team won a Menu Masters Award — the kind of recognition that only happens when systems and people click. I know what it actually takes to run a business, because I've done it on tight margins and long days.

blocks.title: Then I went and built the systems.
blocks.body: As a technology leader, I architect and scale the systems and automation that keep complex operations running — and I'm a power user of the tools that hold it all together. I bring that same enterprise-grade rigor to everything I ship.

blocks.title: I understand the spreadsheet and the experience.
blocks.body: Most technologists have never owned a P&L. Most operators can't build the system. I do both — so what I build is designed to generate results and protect your time, not just to look good in a portfolio.

builds.heading: Three things I've engineered.
builds.lede: An agency and two apps. Different surfaces, same instinct: build the thing that respects the person using it.
builds.thread: Orva and PlainMind share the same blueprint — calm, private, local-first software that respects your attention instead of mining it. I build the antidote to hype.

items.name: Redefined Creative
items.tagline: More booked jobs. Not just a better-looking website.
items.body: My web design and local SEO studio. I build high-performance WordPress systems that turn home-service businesses into the local authority in their market — strategy, design, and the hosting to back it up.

items.name: Orva
items.tagline: The calm operating system for your life.
items.body: A calendar and task app that protects your time instead of maximizing it. It caps your work hours, guards personal time, and drafts tomorrow's plan each night for your approval. Local-first and private — no accounts, no servers.

items.name: PlainMind
items.body: A calm, private place for the links, music, places, and ideas you want to remember. Save from any app in one tap; everything auto-organizes by type, and on-device search finds it again. No feed, no tracking.

philosophy.heading: Systems over guesswork.
philosophy.lede: Four rules that show up in everything I build.

principles.title: Systems over guesswork
principles.body: Decisions backed by how things actually work — data and operating reality — not opinion, ego, or whatever's trending.

principles.title: Built for outcomes
principles.body: A website, an app, a process: it only counts if it moves the number that matters. Pretty is table stakes, not the point.

principles.title: Radical transparency
principles.body: Clear pricing, plain language, no retainer traps. You own what I build for you. No surprises in the back room.

principles.title: Respect the attention
principles.body: The best software gets out of your way. No dark patterns, no infinite feed, no noise. Tools should serve you, not farm you.

connect.heading: Let's build something that works.
connect.lede: Always up for a conversation about technology, operations, or building products. Find me here.

footer.tagline: The magic out front. The systems in the back.
